description: Mechanical parts of django-modern-rest upgrades, consumed by scripts/dmr_upgrade.py. `symbols` are fully qualified renames applied with libcst, `keywords` rename call keyword arguments, `removed` and `manual` are only reported with file locations.

manual.message: Blueprint was removed: merge into a single Controller with components in method parameters
compose_blueprints was removed: use one Controller class with several methods
@sse decorator was removed: use dmr.streaming.sse.SSEController
OpenAPIView.dumps was removed: use dmr.openapi.core.dump.json_dumps or override .get()
provide_response_specs is now an instance method: replace `cls` with `self`
Endpoint.get_schema and Controller.get_path_item need a new `router` parameter
DjangoCache was split: SyncDjangoCache for sync throttles, AsyncDjangoCache for async ones
BaseThrottleBackend was split into BaseThrottleSyncBackend and BaseThrottleAsyncBackend, backends need .incr and .get
BaseThrottleAlgorithm.record was removed: .access must record accesses itself
FileResponseSpec no longer sets Content-Disposition: add as_attachment=True where FileResponse(..., as_attachment=True) is returned
Schema.then was renamed to Schema.schema_then (attribute access is not rewritten automatically)
Controller.get_path_item was renamed to get_schema
skip_validation must be passed as a keyword to OpenAPIView.as_view()
throttling pytest fixtures were removed: call dmr.test.throttling.assert_throttling directly
ExternalURL is protected now: use dmr.routing.external_path() with the same arguments
FileResponseSpec.file_body was renamed to return_type
FileMetadataComponent.schema_metadata was removed: implement SupportsFileParsing.schema_metadata on the parser
JWToken(leeway=...) was removed: pass leeway to JWToken.decode() only
check_auth of JWT refresh and verify controllers now takes (user, token)
custom auth classes must implement the www_authenticate_challenge property
JWToken.encode raises JWTokenError now, not InternalServerError
check_event_field raises dmr.exceptions.ValidationError instead of ValueError
security_requirement property became the security_requirements(metadata, controller_cls) method returning a list
security_schemes is now a method taking (metadata, controller_cls)
NewCookie.as_dict was removed
these ResponseModification methods were removed
cookie flags cannot be None anymore: use False
these OpenAPIFormat members were removed: use plain strings
OpenAPIContext.register_schema was removed: use serializer-native JSON schema tools
prefix_encoding is now a list of Encoding objects
.resolve() now takes the is_async keyword
ResponseSpec.get_schema takes controller_cls instead of serializer
explicit None now means 'generate nothing', drop the argument to use the docstring
